title: Three hundred thousand
logline: The Legacy's odometer, close, turning over 300,000 on 101 in October. A hand on the wheel. Eleven years of Tuesdays.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's dashboard: the odometer reading 299,999 with the last digit half-turned to 300,000, a hand on the wheel at the page's edge, the coastal road through the windshield in October light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on an old station wagon's dashboard with a mechanical odometer half-rolled from 299999 to 300000, a man's hand on the wheel at the edge, a coastal road through the windshield in October light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
